designs.name: AI Agent Fallback Workflow Diagram
designs.look: Two flowcharts, one above the other. The top (red) shows a simple linear path: 'User Request' -> 'AI Agent (Fails)' -> 'Nothing', highlighting a lack of a backup plan. The bottom (green) shows a more complex, robust path: 'User Request' -> 'AI Agent (Fails)' -> 'Escalate' -> 'Pass to next who knows' -> 'Resolved' -> 'Issue resolved'. It also includes a 'Track Every Edge Case' box with sub-steps like 'Log it', 'Categorize it', 'Escalate it', 'Learn from it', and a human icon with a description of human escalation behavior.

designs.name: AI Agent Observability Diagram
designs.look: Two side-by-side diagrams. The left (red) is 'No Visibility', showing an AI agent icon leading to a 'Wilderness' icon with a question mark, implying unknown actions and poor results. The right (green) is 'Full Visibility', showing an AI agent icon leading to a detailed 'Activity & Logs' flowchart (Task started, Retrieved data, Processed, Error occurred, Retrying, Completed) culminating in 'Task done'. Below this, key components like 'Built-in logs', 'Error messaging', 'Performance training', and 'Human oversight' are listed, with a star icon indicating 'Agents get better when watched by humans'.
